text:
liz: Quick sync: we need to pick streaming semantics for chat/completions. Customer asks: resume support, structured deltas, deterministic finish codes. TL;DR: three options: SSE line-events, WS JSON frames, or a hybrid. Thoughts?

ashwin: Prefer WS JSON — easier for mobile multiplexing and bi-directional control frames. But SSE wins on simple proxy compatibility.

kate: Customers (finance + regulated) specifically asked for resume tokens + explicit finish_reason semantics (partial/complete/error). For launch we need: resume + stable finish_reason enum + SDK support.

matt: Tradeoff: resume implies per-session state (cache offsets / resume tokens) and more infra (token storage, expiry, revocation). Might be Dedicated-only at first to limit scope.

ashwin: On delta format, propose a small op-envelope approach: {op: 'token', text: 'foo'}, {op: 'patch', path: '/structured', value: {...}}, {op: 'finish', reason: 'stop'|'cancel'|'error', code: 'string'} — keeps clients simple.

liz: Implementation sketch: SSE lines like:
```
event: delta
data: {"seq": 12, "op": "token", "text": "Hi"}

```
or the same JSON as a WS text frame. We should standardize around JSON deltas with an 'op' envelope and seq numbers.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary of streaming-proto-v2 scheduled for 2026-04-12 :calendar:

kate: Note: mobile networks and proxies often break SSE reconnect/resume. Need fallback: non-streaming full-response API that includes final finish_reason.

matt: Suggested launch gates: (1) SDK streaming clients for Node + Python, (2) finish_reason enums documented, (3) server-side fallback and telemetry for stream failures, (4) latency SLOs verified for streamed path.

ashwin: Function-calling interop: partial function call data must be emitted as deltas with op 'tool_call' and finalization via 'finish' or 'tool_end'. Example: a sequence of {op:'tool_call', id: 't1', chunk: '...'} then {op:'tool_end', id:'t1'}.

liz: We should avoid mixing embeddings scope into this ship — focus on chat/completions streaming first.

kate: Edge cases to cover in spec: interleaved function-call chunks + plain tokens, sequence gaps (seq id mismatch), and client reconnection/resume semantics. We'll require seq ids and optional resume tokens.

matt: Question: do we want to support compressed/binary frames in MVP? that adds complexity to proxies and clients. Maybe defer and add an 'encoding' header later.

ashwin: Prioritization call: MVP = WS JSON deltas + seq + finish_reason + Node/Python SDK samples. SSE parity as follow-up (depends on customer demand). Resume tokens can be a stretch-goal for Hosted, required for Dedicated/Private.

liz: Agreed. Action items: Ashwin -> draft spec with op list, examples, seq semantics (due Tue); Kate -> consolidate customer asks + finalize launch gates (due Tue); Matt -> infra cost and resume-token feasibility (due Wed). I'll loop in PMs and SDK leads.

kate: :thumbsup: I'll add a spreadsheet with customer asks and severity after this thread.

ashwin: Dropping a minimal example delta block I'll put in #product-docs shortly, sample: ```json
{"seq":1,"op":"token","text":"Hel"}
{"seq":2,"op":"token","text":"lo"}
{"seq":3,"op":"finish","reason":"stop","code":"ok"}
```

liz: Also define error codes early: 'model_unavailable', 'quota_exceeded', 'invalid_resume_token', 'stream_timeout'. Keep codes as short strings for SDK mapping.

matt: Noted. If we gate resume to Dedicated, update Console UX to expose a resume toggle and show storage/retention terms.

liz: Great discussion. We'll reconvene after Ashwin's spec draft. If anyone has blocking objections to WS-first approach, call them out now.
